short_title: Cohort size, scenes and Pu.1+ fractions per animal
method: Count segmented cells and collaborator Pu1_class per scene/section/animal
unit: cell, aggregated per scene, section and animal
key_result: 218,746 cells, 29% Pu.1+; Pu.1+ fraction ~9% (CFA control) to ~46% (P2_3 thoracic); 22/36/17/35 lesions per scene.

short_title: Lesion vs control sections decided by manual cores
method: Sections with manual cores are lesion sections (focus: manual)
validation: None; lesion presence defined by annotation
key_result: 8 lesion sections (16 slide × sections), lesion area 0.4–27.7%; unrestricted detector still calls up to 6.3% in EAE control sections.

short_title: Pu.1+ density threshold detector as baseline
method: Robust z of smoothed Pu.1+ density, hysteresis, 40-setting grid
unit: 10 µm grid bin; manual core detection per scene
key_result: Best setting finds 95.5% of manual cores but outlines ~3.7–5× manual core area and 0.14 mm² in controls; over-calls canal and grey matter.

short_title: Supervised gradient-boosting lesion model trained on manual cores
method: HistGradientBoosting on 19 per-bin density/intensity/position features
unit: 10 µm grid bin (held out by scene)
key_result: Held-out AP 0.68–0.92, 79–95% of cores detected; final pipeline coverage lower (64–90%, §7); between-animal generalisation untested.

short_title: Visual judgement of lesion outlines per section
method: Composite image galleries with automatic and manual outlines
key_result: Qualitative only: galleries of 22/36/17/35 lesions per scene and control sections; no written assessment exists.

short_title: Lesion zones scaled to section size; Pu.1+ fraction by zone
method: Zones as fractions of equivalent section radius; signed distances
key_result: Rim ~5%, peri/deep ~15% of radius (rim 36–62 µm); Pu.1+ fraction core 0.47, rim 0.43, peri/deep 0.30, distal 0.23.

short_title: Automatic vs manual lesion cores compared
method: Per-core overlap, IoU, missed-core galleries, cell confusion table
unit: manual core polygon and cell, per scene
key_result: Auto lesions cover 85–90% of manual core area, miss 28/112 mostly small cores; 85–91% annotated core cells in auto core/rim; meninges-core conflict with §13.

short_title: Eligible Pu.1+ cells per capture site
method: Count eligible Pu.1+ cells per section × compartment
key_result: ~34k eligible Pu.1+ in lesion sections (core 9,962, rim 6,805, rings 20,860); controls GM 6,159, WM 1,772; R1_3 very few core cells.

short_title: Collaborator-style LMD wells formed and exported
method: Pick Pu.1+ cells to 3,000 µm² per group; Leica XML
key_result: 41/30/41/30 wells per scene; many short in R1_3 and WM; 64–75% overlap with collaborator's selection; placeholder calibration marks.

short_title: Mass-spec reaction plan within 60-reaction budget
method: Pool eligible cells per section × compartment; tiered control pooling
validation: Budget and shortfall check against protocol rules
key_result: 57 of 60 reactions, 36,988 cells; OS control pooling needed (61 otherwise); 22 reactions short of 200 cells, 15 of them VBO.

short_title: Fixed 30 µm meninges band trade-off sweep
method: Sweep band widths 0–100 µm against tissue surface distance
key_result: 30 µm band removes 11–17% lesion-section Pu.1+ and 3–10% manual-core Pu.1+; corrected: the 100 µm edge exclusion (§14), not the band, kept subpial lesion out.

short_title: Adaptive three-tier meninges diagnostic
method: Per-location meninges/buffer/parenchyma from nuclear compactness near surface
validation: Compared with 30 µm band; exploration only
key_result: Swollen meninges near lesions reach 60–80 µm (p95 up to 79 µm); ~5.3k lesion-zone Pu.1+ cells fall in meninges/buffer; superseded by §13.

short_title: Adaptive meninges boundary with protected manual cores
method: Seed layer, flaps, 99.9th-percentile compact growth; cores protected
validation: Manual-core cells in meninges must be 0
key_result: 0 manual-core cells in meninges/buffer; 5,359 lesion-section Pu.1+ set aside as meninges; unchecked against annotation; conflicts with §7 confusion table.

short_title: Edge exclusion lowered from 100 to 40 µm
method: Sweep edge margins 0–100 µm; reaction totals per setting
validation: Visual check of raggedness at surface
key_result: 100 µm margin dropped ~9.5k subpial lesion Pu.1+ cells; 40 µm gives 36,988 cells, 22 shortfalls; corrects §11's attribution.

short_title: Collection plan shown section by section
method: Per-section maps of collected cells, meninges, buffer, edge lines
validation: Sanity checks by manual annotation and surface tier
key_result: 36,988 cells (98% Pu.1+) in 57 reactions; 8,616 from R1_2_T to 444 in R1_3_T, none in R1_2_C; 0 manual-core cells in meninges.

short_title: Pu.1 and Iba1 higher near lesions than distal
method: log2 compartment/distal median, Wilcoxon over sections
key_result: Rim Pu.1 1.25× distal (8/8, p=0.008), Iba1 ~1.3×, nuclei ~10% smaller; §18 shows crowding confound partly; §20 supports per-cell rise.

short_title: Pu.1 and Iba1 gradient against distance to lesion edge
method: Median normalised intensity per distance bin per slide
key_result: Pu.1 peaks ~1.25–1.43× control at the edge, falls to ~1× by 500–800 µm; CML_2_rescan differs; '~250 µm' claim unbacked by table.

short_title: Crowding check: zones compared at matched local density
method: Median raw Pu.1 per neighbour-count quantile bin × compartment
validation: None; no test, no section pairing
key_result: Lesion zones exceed distal only in sparse/middle bins; in densest bin distal is highest (4.87 vs 4.19–4.44); STATUS 'holds' overstated.

short_title: Pu.1 rim effect per section, slide, animal and level
method: Per slide × section log2 effects; heatmaps; replicate correlation
key_result: Rim above distal in 16/16 slide × sections, every animal and level; replicate slides agree moderately (Spearman r=0.53).

short_title: More Pu.1 per cell or a different cell mix
method: GMM morphological types; within-type paired tests; composition decomposition
validation: Within-type Wilcoxon; BIC choice of k=3 questionable
key_result: Type mix barely shifts; per-cell part explains ~85–106% of the difference; rim Pu.1 rises within every type (e.g. round 1.29×, 7/7).

short_title: Elongated nucleus share per compartment
method: Eccentricity classes; shares per compartment; paired vs distal
key_result: Meninges 29% elongated vs 15% distal, for Pu.1− and Pu.1+ alike (~+10 pp, 7/8); lesion compartments match distal; extended in §23.

short_title: Typical zoom-in windows of nuclei per compartment
method: Representative 120 µm windows chosen near compartment median eccentricity
key_result: Flattened elongated nuclei along meningeal surface, little shape difference core/rim/distal; selected windows, replaced by random galleries in §26.

short_title: Meninges vs own parenchyma elongation, all sections
method: Elongated share difference; sign test, Wilcoxon, hierarchical bootstrap
validation: Hierarchical bootstrap over animals then sections
key_result: Meninges +13.3 pp elongated vs parenchyma (95% CI 9.7–16.9), 16/17 sections incl. control animals; only exception P3_1_C.

short_title: Robustness checks of meningeal elongation
method: Repeat §23 across cut-offs, solidity, size, Pu.1 status, edge control
validation: Nine checks, same sections, bootstrap CIs
key_result: Effect survives every check: e.g. edge control +12.2 pp (CI 9.3–15.0), Pu.1+ only +12.3 pp; checks not independent.

short_title: Elongation by depth and meningeal layer
method: Depth profile per slide; 0–10/10–30/30–80 µm layer split
unit: section (n=13–18); cells per slide for profile
validation: Paired Wilcoxon outer vs deeper layers
key_result: Outer ≤10 µm layer 31% elongated, ~80% Pu.1−; outer beats 10–30 µm in 17/18 (+9.8 pp); deeper meninges at parenchyma level.

short_title: Random meninges windows vs slide parenchyma
method: Random 120 µm windows; tally elongated share vs slide parenchyma
key_result: Meninges windows beat parenchyma only 13/24 (distal 8/12): window-level effect not seen; heterogeneity, does not contradict section level.

short_title: Meningeal cellularity against distance to nearest lesion
method: 100 µm surface segments; nuclei per 100 µm; control-p95 swollen threshold
key_result: 7.5 nuclei/100 µm near lesions vs 4.2 far vs 3.2 control; 30% near-lesion surface swollen vs 10%, 5%; section-level weaker (§28).

short_title: Near vs far and lesion vs control swelling per section
method: Section medians; paired Wilcoxon near−far; Mann–Whitney lesion vs control
key_result: Near > far in 6/8 (p=0.078, not significant); lesion > control sections 5.3 vs 3.2 (p=0.02, 1.7× not 2×); thickness barely responds.

short_title: Swelling per animal and level, incl. lesion-free EAE sections
method: Per slide × section swollen % summarised per animal and level
key_result: Control animals 1–3% swollen surface vs EAE animals 6–18%, incl. lesion-free EAE sections (R1_2_L ~12–14%); no test, R1_2_C tiny.

short_title: Maps and zoom-ins of most swollen meningeal spots
method: Section maps by cellularity; top-six segment zoom-ins
key_result: Swelling up to ~100–190 nuclei/100 µm, 4 of 6 top spots within 100 µm of a lesion; top spot (Pu.1-poor) possibly artefact, uninterpreted.

short_title: Elongated outer-meningeal nuclei lie parallel to surface
method: Nucleus long axis vs surface direction; order parameter S
key_result: Outer layer S=0.61, 74% within 30° of surface; ΔS +0.39 vs near-surface parenchyma (CI 0.37–0.57) in 17/17 sections.

short_title: Surface alignment against depth
method: Order parameter of elongated nuclei per depth bin per slide
unit: cells pooled per slide × depth bin
validation: Shuffle null for pooled deep group
key_result: S ≈0.54–0.64 at 0–10 µm, ~0 by 80–100 µm, slightly radial (−0.13) at 150–300 µm; values from figure only.

short_title: Robustness of surface alignment
method: Recompute ΔS under cut-off, smoothing, solidity, Pu.1, lesion status
validation: Ten alternative settings plus random windows
key_result: ΔS 0.28–0.54 under every check (e.g. Pu.1+ 0.37, 11/12; control sections 0.54, 9/9); random windows uniformly parallel.

short_title: Can nuclear shape alone predict rule-defined meninges
method: Gradient boosting on shape, density, Pu.1, one-sidedness features
validation: Leave-one-animal-out; labels from the rule itself
key_result: Shape only AUC 0.72, AP 0.26 (base 0.11); geometry reaches 0.87 but relearns the rule; real labels needed.

short_title: Meninges annotation targets and training/evaluation setup
method: Select 300 µm boxes by kind; napari layers; LOAO training chain
validation: Dry run on rule-derived fake labels
key_result: 8 sections from every animal, 31 boxes (6 core-at-surface, 8 swollen, 1 internal, 8 bare, 8 typical); chain works; no real labels yet.
